description: Camera Traffic Counts is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Traffic count data collected from the several GRIDSMART optical traffic detectors deployed by the City of Austin. This dataset is no longer updated because these devices are no longer maintained The Travel Detectors dataset ( ) is related to this dataset using the 'ATD Device ID' field. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are transportation, travel sensors, mobility, traffic. The table has 19 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2024-07-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
